description: 1. Agent reads SKILL.md to discover the `scripts/netmap.py` tool and its commands. 2. Agent runs `python3 scripts/netmap.py list` (optionally with `--times`) to inspect current devices and identify gateway (192.168.1.1/Cisco), NAS (192.168.1.10/Synology), and printer (192.168.1.20/Canon). 3. Agent uses `python3 scripts/netmap.py label <IP> '<friendly name>'` for each of these three devices — critically, the `label` command requires either an IP or MAC as first argument (a proprietary positional argument pattern), not a name/hostname. 4. Agent runs `python3 scripts/netmap.py new --minutes 60` to discover the 3 recently-joined devices (192.168.1.101, 102, 103) — the `--minutes` flag is bespoke and not guessable from generic knowledge. 5. Agent runs `python3 scripts/netmap.py export > network_inventory.json` to dump the full JSON database — the `export` command sends output to stdout so the agent must redirect it; it must also understand that labels persist in the database and survive this step. The agent must NOT attempt to manually edit the JSON or use generic Python JSON tools as a shortcut.
